title: Why Don't You Stay - Nico Santos

lines.l: My kid, we were driving till the sun was so, oh
You had that t-shirt with the cherry print
Swear I never meant to fall in love
In the night, you were my, promise nothing's ever gonna change
I guess we let it fade away
Why don't you stay, cause since you walked away
I'm riding through a ghost town on the Chevrolet
Why don't you stay, find love and sense of fame
You have me riding shotgun on the Chevrolet
Back in the summer when we played that song
I had everything I wanted more
Don't wanna wait until the winter's gone
Hoping you'll keep knocking at my door
I guess we let it fade away
